🤎 CROCKTOBER: EPISODE 13 🤎  CHOCOLATE LAVA CAKE 🍫 INGREDIENTS For the cake: 🍰 1 box Super Moist Chocolate Fudge or Milk Chocolate Cake Mix  🥛 1¼ cups milk 🛢️ ½ cup vegetable oil 🥚 3 eggs For the chocolate lava topping: 🍮 1 box (4 oz) instant chocolate pudding mix 🥛 2 cups milk 🍫 1 bag (12 oz) milk chocolate chips DIRECTIONS 1️⃣ Spray your crockpot with nonstick cooking spray. 2️⃣ Prepare the chocolate cake mix according to the package directions, using the milk, oil, and eggs listed above. 3️⃣ Pour the cake batter into the crockpot. 4️⃣ Prepare the instant chocolate pudding according to the package directions using 2 cups of milk. 5️⃣ Pour the pudding over the cake batter. DO NOT STIR! 🙅🏻‍♀️ 6️⃣ Sprinkle the entire bag of chocolate chips evenly over the top. 7️⃣ Cover and cook on LOW until the cake is set around the edges and gooey in the center. Start checking around 2 hours, since crockpots vary. Avoid lifting the lid too often! Scoop it into a bowl while it’s warm and top with vanilla ice cream. The hot-and-cold combination? Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes 🍫 🎄❄️ (Makes 4) Ingredients:  • ½ cup unsalted butter (113g)  • 6 oz chocolate chips or chopped chocolate (168g / 1 cup)  • 2 large eggs + 2 large egg yolks  • ¼ cup granulated sugar (50g)  • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour (16g)  • ⅛ tsp salt • Powdered sugar for snow ❄️ Instructions:  1.  Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C). Butter four 6oz ramekins & dust with cocoa powder.  2. Melt butter + chocolate together in 30s microwave intervals until smooth.  3. Whisk whole eggs, yolks, sugar, & salt for 1–2 mins until slightly pale.  4. Whisk chocolate into the egg mixture, then gently fold in flour until combined.  5. Divide batter into ramekins & bake for 12–14 mins (edges firm, center jiggly!).  8. 8. Rest for EXACTLY 1 minute, run a thin knife around the edge, flip onto a plate, & dust with powdered sugar for that snowy holiday finish! ❄️✨ #christmasbaking #christmas #baking #lavacake #christmasdessert

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie

This is why I love custom cakes—every order is a chance to create something completely unique.
